top_story.headline: No new FEC compliance filings surfaced since the last edition
top_story.dek: All 96 RFAI and Form 99 filings in the window were already reported in earlier editions.
paragraphs: The scripts found 96 FEC RFAI and Form 99 filings received since October 16, 2026, but every one of them was already reported in a prior edition, so nothing new is listed today. No red-flag keyword hits and no voided or negative transactions of $10,000 or more turned up in new data.
The FEC's API (api.open.fec.gov) was unreachable during this run, so the absence of new items may partly reflect that gap rather than a quiet day at the agency.

sections.headline: Nothing new in Deadline Watch after removing items already reported
paragraphs: 1 sitting member' campaigns filed the October Quarterly (Q3) report late.

footer.coverage_window: FEC RFAI (FRQ) and Form 99 filings received October 16, 2026 onward, checked on the afternoon of Monday, October 19, 2026 (Pacific).
footer.sources: FEC filings API; FEC Schedule A/B itemized transactions.

apod.title: Treble Clef: Unusual X-ray Hot Radio Source
apod.caption: What is Treble Clef? This unusual radio structure extends over 2 million light-years and resembles a common musical symbol -- but has its visible light hidden by our own Milky Way Galaxy.
apod.credit: X-ray: NASA/CXC/INAF-IRA/A. Botteon et al.; Infrared: UKIDSS-GPS; Radio: ASTRONLOFAR; Image processing: NASA/CXC/SAO/N. Wolk / science.nasa.gov/apod
